content.text:
Rolled back **checkout-api** from v2.3.1 to **v2.3.0**, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions: us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

Verified the service is healthy; error rate dropped from **18% to 0.2%**.

Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the rollback and verification, and paged the on-call engineer.
